verdict.rationale: Extensive first-party docs and product pages describe DGX B200 multi-GPU systems, NVLink/NVSwitch fabric, cluster/data-center management (Mission Control, DGX SuperPOD), and rack-scale turnkey deployment, corroborated by community reports confirming real-world performance and multi-GPU NVLink usage in production. Missing for 10: independent third-party benchmark/deployment reports at full rack/SuperPOD scale beyond a single HN thread.
